ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Work status
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Maintenance work orders opened, completed and cancelled in a period, and the backlog, overdue and unassigned at its end, by state, team, resource or source.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Opened, first completed and cancelled in the period; backlog as of a time

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: PM compliance
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Preventive obligations due in a period, each on time, late, outstanding, skipped or unknown, over the obligations due, not the work orders made.
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.basis: Due date in the period, as of a time

ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.title: Maintenance costs
ironstone.insights.ReportCatalogEntry.description: Parts, labor at the costing rate and outside service of maintenance work, each source once, by currency; unapproved and unpriced hours apart.

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Maintenance backlog
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Maintenance work orders open at a moment (in planning, approved, in progress or on hold).
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: As of a time, from the status history
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Open: not complete, closed or cancelled
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.allowedDimensions: state, team, resource, source, kind, organization
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, facilityId, assetId, teamPartyId, sourceEnumId, maintenanceKindEnumId, thruDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Procedures and process steps; a work order not yet created at the as-of time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations; a maintenance reader

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: Overdue preventive maintenance
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Preventive obligations past their due date and not done, in a period.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: Due date in the period, as of a time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.statusBasis: Outstanding: passed and not done (a coalesced one until its catch-up is done)
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, maintenanceScheduleId, assetId, facilityId, fromDate, thruDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Unknown obligations (no time zone, no meter reading, a stale meter) and those not yet due
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations; a maintenance reader

ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.title: On-time preventive maintenance
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.description: Preventive obligations satisfied by their due date over the obligations due, in a period.
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.dateBasis: Due date in the period, as of a time
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.numerator: Obligations satisfied by their due date
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.denominator: Obligations due: on time, late, outstanding and skipped
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.supportedFilters: organizationPartyId, maintenanceScheduleId, assetId, facilityId, fromDate, thruDate
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.exclusions: Unknown obligations and those not yet due are named, never in the denominator; a skipped or coalesced one is not compliant
ironstone.insights.MetricRegistration.scopePolicy: The viewer's organizations; a maintenance reader
